svg.aria-label: Font specimen, three SIL OFL candidates
svg.title: Font specimen, three SIL OFL candidates
svg.text: FONT SPECIMEN · THREE SIL OFL CANDIDATES
One display serif per concept; one figure face for all three.
Every figure on a plate is set in IBM Plex Mono: it is the only monospace candidate measured to carry the rupee sign.
m0070 never receives its receivable from m0008, due at hour 19.
m0070 never receives its receivable from m0008, due at hour 19.
m0070 never receives its receivable from m0008, due at hour 19.
Checked in the WOFF2 files: a cmap entry for U+20B9 and a 'tnum' GSUB feature.
A monospace face is fixed-width, so its figures line up without a 'tnum' feature. Libre Caslon Text has no ₹: on Board B a rupee
sign inside serif text falls back to a system face; figures stay in Plex Mono either way.
All four faces are self-hosted from npm @fontsource packages, subset and embedded in each SVG. Licence texts: design/fonts/licenses/.
